profile.headline: Software Engineer @Microsoft
profile.summary: Hello, my name is Jaylin! I am an ambitious and eager scholar who desires to gain and use experiences, technical or social, to positively influence the lives of others around.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Skills: Azure Logic Apps · Microsoft Power Platform · C# · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Computer Center Assistant
positions.description:
-Designed the homepage of all computers for A&T’s College of Engineering Computers
-Assists the College’s computer technicians to maintain servers and order in the computer labs

company.name: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Developed an automation application for Microsoft's Intelligent Conversations and Communications Cloud (IC3) team 
-Scaled an 100 hour/month process down to 2-3 hour/month thus saving time and money for Microsoft
-Gained hands-on development experience in Azure Cloud services including Logic Apps, Cosmos DB, Automation and Microsoft's Power Platform
positions.insights: Skills: Azure Logic Apps · Cloud Applications · Azure Key Vault · Azure DevOps · Azure Cosmos DB

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Managed and developed a project on the Substrate Intelligence team with a focus on Search testing at Microsoft
-Researched and presented information on new testing approach to team leaders
-Gained hands-on experience in back-end software engineering using C# and .NET infrastructure

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description:
-Gained hands-on experience in project management and software engineering using C# 
-Managed and developed an end-to-end skill on the Cortana team at Microsoft 
-Created specification guides for the project and future development of Microsoft services 
-Enhanced software to execute services for the project that will later be implemented into real Microsoft products

projects.title: StudyXL
projects.description:
-Created a solution to provide K-12 students with an AI app that caters to their specific learning styles
-Lead a team of 3 students in processing a machine learning algorithm to personalize the learning application for each student

projects.title: Aggie Goods
projects.description:
-Created a solution to a current food desert crisis in the city of Greensboro
-Lead a team of engineering students to find a solution which was later proposed to a panel of College of Engineering faculty and students
